races.name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk Nursery
races.verdict:
HARRY'S POP is thriving and still looks on a workable mark. He can complete the hat-trick in the opener. Maximus Meridius and Resemblance are the principal dangers.

  1. HARRY'S POP
  2. MAXIMUS MERIDIUS (IRE)
  3. RESEMBLANCE (IRE)

races.name: betting.bet New Betting Sites/EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ONGOMBO finds himself in calmer waters after a creditable run at Doncaster earlier this month and can get off the mark. Likely improver Reddy looks the obvious danger.

  1. ONGOMBO
  2. REDDY
  3. SO SEXY ME

races.name: betting.bet Play Champion Tipster Handicap
races.verdict:
Course winner HAPPIER was a ready scorer for Toby Moore at Kempton last week and makes plenty of appeal in her follow-up bid. Son of Astar and Call Time are feared most.

  1. HAPPIER (IRE)
  2. SON OF ASTAR
  3. CALL TIME (IRE)

races.name: betting.bet Free Racing Tips Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
TORCELLO is at the veteran stage now but showed how effective he remains, granted testing conditions, at Haydock in May. Still nicely treated on old form, he gets the nod here. Feelin' Free and Captain Cairney head the list of dangers.

  1. TORCELLO (IRE)
  2. FEELIN' FREE
  3. CAPTAIN CAIRNEY

races.name: Red Lion Llandyfaelog Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This looks a match between the 3-y-os, AERIAL SILK getting the nod to open his account back in novice company having struggled to get competitive in a couple of handicaps earlier in the season. Lucky Radar shaped with plenty of promise at Chepstow first time up 3 weeks ago and he can push the selection close.

  1. AERIAL SILK
  2. LUCKY RADAR (IRE)
  3. CIRCLE OF SECRETS (FR)

races.name: RHN Travel Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
ARVANA BELLE didn't get the breaks at Bath last time and had run a cracker here previously. She can return to winning ways. Scarfo and Beaming Light should also go well.

  1. ARVANA BELLE (IRE)
  2. SCARFO (IRE)
  3. BEAMING LIGHT

races.name: RHN Travel Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
WHITELEY WAY finally got off the mark at Lingfield back in the spring and having been found a weak-looking race on return, Gary Brown's mare gets the verdict to follow up with Oisin Murphy taking over in the plate. Angel's Call was beaten only by one who has dropped a long way in the weights at Bath recently, so he can provide most resistance, with Ajrad rounding off the shortlist.

  1. WHITELEY WAY
  2. ANGEL'S CALL (IRE)
  3. AJRAD

races.name: Dandara Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
ZAMBEZI MAGIC loves it around here and provided he can leave a lesser effort behind returned to class 6 company, he's fancied to add a seventh C&D success to his tally. Rogers Dream opened her account in impressive fashion at Ripon last month, so she heads up the dangers back in a handicap, with Elora Prince and City Escape taken to fight out third.

  1. ZAMBEZI MAGIC
  2. ROGERS DREAM
  3. ELORA PRINCE (IRE)

races.name: Racing TV Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
APRIL DIAMOND showed improved form when opening her account at Carlisle last month and she can build on that effort as she goes up in trip. She is taken to get the better of Little Ted, who should be thereabouts once more back down in grade, with Hostelry also in the mix.

  1. APRIL DIAMOND (IRE)
  2. LITTLE TED
  3. HOSTELRY

races.name: Evolution, Your Partner For Fastener Solutions EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
BY JOVE GRACE has the edge on form and experience and can finally open her account. Stablemate Kumharas showed a bit on debut and appeals as second choice.

  1. BY JOVE GRACE (IRE)
  2. KUMHARAS
  3. MRS BLUE (FR)

races.name: Watch Racing TV Free For 31 Days Handicap
races.verdict:
Quite an open race but the vote goes to FANS FAVOURITE who had excuses last time and goes very well in soft conditions. Spanish Hustle looks to be coming to the boil based on his latest outing and can go well again, with Unchartedterritory also entitled to be in the mix. Northern Brave and Perseus Way are others to consider.

  1. FANS FAVOURITE
  2. SPANISH HUSTLE
  3. UNCHARTEDTERRITORY (IRE)

races.name: Sir Ian Good Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
LITTLE MI MI has proven a revelation with 5 wins this year, the latest over C&D last month, so she is well worth another chance having had excuses at York 15 days ago. She gets the vote ahead of Stormy Impact, who should be suited by the return to softer ground, while Arklow Lad also has possibilities in a change of headgear.

  1. LITTLE MI MI (IRE)
  2. STORMY IMPACT
  3. ARKLOW LAD (IRE)

races.name: Heineken Low & No Bar Handicap
races.verdict:
A competitive-looking race, with the vote going to the bottom-weight TANJEN, who again went close at Doncaster last week. The consistent Thornaby Pearl and recent Catterick winner Military Girl are next on the shortlist in a race where it's difficult to fully rule any of them out.

  1. TANJEN (IRE)
  2. THORNABY PEARL
  3. MILITARY GIRL (IRE)

races.name: Get Closer With A RacingTV Free Trial Handicap
races.verdict:
The consistent FARANDAWAY impressed on the clock when scoring at Ripon at the start of this month and he can follow up after a 3 lb rise. City Captain returned from a break to win at C&D last month and makes appeal again, as does course specialist Belsito.

  1. FARANDAWAY (IRE)
  2. CITY CAPTAIN
  3. BELSITO (GER)

races.name: Start Your RacingTV Free Trial Now Confined Handicap
races.verdict:
Only a few make any real appeal in this low-grade handicap with BAY BREEZE taken to regain the winning thread having dropped to a dangerous mark. Edmond Halley and Lesley's Boy make most appeal of the rest.

  1. BAY BREEZE
  2. EDMOND HALLEY (IRE)
  3. LESLEY'S BOY

races.name: HSBC UK Agriculture Nursery
races.verdict:
It's possible to make a case for all of these but top of the list is PARADING, who shaped well at Ffos Las on his penultimate start and wasn't seen to best effect on all-weather at Lingfield last time. Pequenita has been knocking on the door in similar races and is second choice ahead of recent Bath scorer Q T Boy.

  1. PARADING
  2. PEQUENITA
  3. Q T BOY

races.name: Racing Bet-Builder At Spreadex Sports Fillies' Nursery
races.verdict:
There are a few potential improvers in this big-field nursery but the hat-trick seeking BLADEY LADY should still prove a tough nut to crack. It was striking how far she and the runner-up pulled clear of 14 others in a similar race at Thirsk last week and she can make light of a penalty. Promising nursery newcomers Lovely Dark Angel, Soeur de Flash, Sioux Moon and Babzini head the dangers.

  1. BLADEY LADY (IRE)
  2. LOVELY DARK ANGEL (IRE)
  3. SOEUR DE FLASH

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ESCALATE hails from a precocious family that connections have had plenty of success with, and he gets the nod in this newcomers race. Warrior Knight is another standout on paper, with Zaeer Al Leith and Poole Bay also respected for top yards.

  1. ESCALATE
  2. WARRIOR KNIGHT (IRE)
  3. ZAEER AL LEITH

races.name: S & D Bookmakers Ltd 60 Years In Business - EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Following a promising debut second at Newmarket, there are high hopes that WADOODA can go one better on her reappearance. Summer In Paris may take silver at the expense of Maldives and Allaire, provided she settles on return to action.

  1. WADOODA
  2. SUMMER IN PARIS
  3. MALDIVES (IRE)

races.name: Pattinson Auction Winning Bid Handicap
races.verdict:
MAGIC MUSIC found testing ground taking a toll on her late on over 7f at Haydock last time but she hit the front briefly in the penultimate furlong and might be worth siding with back at shorter. Act of Violence has made a bright start to life with Tony Carroll and is an obvious danger. Maid In Devon and The Flying Seagull also make the shortlist.

  1. MAGIC MUSIC
  2. ACT OF VIOLENCE
  3. MAID IN DEVON

races.name: Fireworks Festival 7th November 2026 - Book Now Handicap
races.verdict:
GLEN NEVIS had heavy ground as a possible excuse at Beverley and is given another chance to confirm the promise of his Newmarket second. The main opposition may come from fellow 3-y-os Bearin Up, Island Bear and Tamzan.

  1. GLEN NEVIS
  2. BEARIN UP (IRE)
  3. ISLAND BEAR (IRE)

races.name: Visit racingtv.com Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
VIOLET GOLDSMITH was clear of the rest when second at Kempton recently and could still be nicely treated even after a 3 lb nudge. Fellow 3-y-os Ridger and Credit Forgedd It head the dangers along with Midnight's Dream and last year's winner Albeyours.

  1. VIOLET GOLDSMITH
  2. RIDGER (IRE)
  3. CREDIT FORGEDD IT (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Ross Burdon's new recruit GIFTS DIFFERING caught the eye when a promising second at Newcastle last time and can go build on it to go one better here off just a 1 lb higher mark. The Anthony Gover looks the main threat on the back of his cosy C&D success, while John Harrison and Chesneys Charm need factoring in for minor honours.

  1. GIFTS DIFFERING
  2. THE ANTHONY GOVER
  3. JOHN HARRISON

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap
races.verdict:
JACK LANGLEY has made a positive start to life under Charlie Clover and is taken to bag a second success for the yard on his first go on tapeta at the chief expense of Kingdom of Stars, who also arrives in good order.

  1. JACK LANGLEY
  2. KINGDOM OF STARS (FR)
  3. LAST TRUMP

races.name: Download The At The Races App Nursery
races.verdict:
CALEF caught the eye on her nursery debut when an unlucky-in-running fourth over C&D recently and can build on it to get off the mark here. Lady of Hay wasn't seen to ideal effect when finishing a place behind her that day and could prove the main danger. Both Chianti (second) and Time And Effort (eighth) also contested that same nursery and can have a say too.

  1. CALEF (IRE)
  2. LADY OF HAY
  3. CHIANTI

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
A tough call to split REICHENBACH FALLS and Aljoon, but Stuart Williams' charge may be able to improve from his debut to take this.

  1. REICHENBACH FALLS
  2. ALJOON (IRE)
  3. BENINGBROUGH HALL

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Lots of these arrive with a question mark against them so it could be worth siding with Ed Bethell's unexposed JOUD to take a sizeable step forward on her handicap debut and get off the mark. Cuban Fiesta has an absence to overcome but could have a say, while it's too early to write off Tortola given the market support that came for her here on Friday.

  1. JOUD
  2. CUBAN FIESTA
  3. TORTOLA (IRE)

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
It could prove worth siding with James Owen's NAUTICAL SKY to take another step forward now dropped in trip and fitted with a visor and gain a first victory. Distillation is feared most on the back of a near-miss here on Friday, while Based and Ndoto also command respect in this open handicap.

  1. NAUTICAL SKY
  2. DISTILLATION (FR)
  3. BASED (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On X Handicap
races.verdict:
HIGHLAND OLLY races off an 11 lb lower mark than he would on turf and with this drop back in trip also a likely plus he is worth siding with to bag a fourth success of the season. Espanita is feared most in her own bid for a fourth win of 2026 ahead of The Hare Rail and Meritocratic.

  1. HIGHLAND OLLY
  2. ESPANITA (IRE)
  3. THE HARE RAIL (IRE)

races.name: Book Now At wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk Handicap
races.verdict:
Harriet Bethell's filly SATYRESS continues on the up and gets a confident vote to extend her winning spree to five going unpenalised for her comfortable victory in a Thirsk apprentice handicap a week ago. Recent Lingfield scorer Arlecchino's Rex appeals as the one to chase her home, while Lawmans Blis and Highland Harvey also need factoring in for minor honours.

  1. SATYRESS
  2. ARLECCHINO'S REX
  3. LAWMANS BLIS (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
Enthusiastic front runner FAR TOO FIZZY looks the pick at the weights. Stable-switcher The Caribbean and Daytona Lady could be the beneficiaries if the pace is overly strong. Cosmic Clarets also needs considering on first run for a new yard.

  1. FAR TOO FIZZY
  2. THE CARIBBEAN (IRE)
  3. DAYTONA LADY (IRE)

races.name: Winter Festival Early Bird Ticket Claiming Race
races.verdict:
EIGHTEENTH SMILES will be tough to beat if reproducing the level of his recent Cork maiden success. Cudawudashuda and Shesthedevil can fight it out for the forecast spot.

  1. EIGHTEENTH SMILES (IRE)
  2. CUDAWUDASHUDA (IRE)
  3. SHESTHEDEVIL (IRE)

races.name: Kilminfoyle House Stud Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
ALMEIYDA has proved expensive to follow but the addition of a first-time visor could be the catalyst for a breakthrough success. Stooked makes plenty of appeal on her early-season form, though stall 20 isn't the ideal draw as she attempts to bounce back. Divine Legend, Nautic Star and River Trieux also need considering in an open-looking maiden.

  1. ALMEIYDA (IRE)
  2. STOOKED (IRE)
  3. DIVINE LEGEND (IRE)

races.name: La Bucca Restaurant Handicap
races.verdict:
A big-field handicap and a case can be made for several, but GIVEHERTILXMAS has been in fine form at Roscommon and gets the vote to open her account under Colin Keane. Blues Emperor is on a dangerous mark and can back up his latest effort, with Moyassr taken to see out the places. Naoi and Phoenix Pairc are others to consider.

  1. GIVEHERTILXMAS (IRE)
  2. BLUES EMPEROR (IRE)
  3. MOYASSR (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks wide open and it could pay to side with BELLA COLOMBIA to build on the promise of her unlucky-in-running Leopardstown ninth and bag a fourth success of the season. The reliable Hugo's Girl heads the list of dangers on the back of a breakthrough Laytown victory, although the Joseph O'Brien-trained pair Never The Same and Mai Dahlia look to have more to offer and can also play a part.

  1. BELLA COLOMBIA (IRE)
  2. HUGO'S GIRL (IRE)
  3. NEVER THE SAME (IRE)

races.name: Castlebridge Consignment Blenheim Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
LIVENKA looked a smart prospect prior to her run in the Round Tower, and with no ground concerns on this occasion, she may well resume winning ways. Group-1 entered Marco Polo is feared most stepping back up in class, with Big Negotiator best of the rest.

  1. LIVENKA
  2. MARCO POLO (IRE)
  3. BIG NEGOTIATOR

races.name: Fairyhouse.ie Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
This represents a drop in class for APRIL MIST, who gets the vote in a tricky nursery. Bold Commander has a solid chance at the weights if revitalised by a first-time visor, with nursery debutants Ocean Surge and Pink Venom also appealing.

  1. APRIL MIST (IRE)
  2. BOLD COMMANDER (IRE)
  3. OCEAN SURGE (IRE)

races.name: Fairyhouse Return Of The Jumps On October 10th Handicap
races.verdict:
BAD BOY RIZZ is given a chance to atone for a lesser run at Navan as he'd been a model of consistency this year prior to that. Colin Keane's mount Nouvel Espoir has been in cracking form and heads the many dangers along with Clonmacash and Bundle of Interest, who is well handicapped again but her draw could be tricky.

  1. BAD BOY RIZZ (IRE)
  2. NOUVEL ESPOIR (IRE)
  3. CLONMACASH

races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
DAWNMORE progressed from his debut when runner-up at Naas 4 days ago, beaten only by a fellow improver, and he could be ready to go one better this time around. Magna Victoria makes plenty of appeal on paper for Joseph O'Brien and is next on the list, ahead of Williamsburg.

  1. DAWNMORE (IRE)
  2. MAGNA VICTORIA (IRE)
  3. WILLIAMSBURG (IRE)

races.name: GAIN The Advantage Series Handicap
races.verdict:
ZARAAHMANDO had been holding his form well prior to seeing his run of in-frame efforts coming to a halt last week, so he is taken to quickly get back on track returned to this grade. Wegotogether has run well upped to 1m the last twice and could be the main danger, with Green Kite and Majestic King completing the shortlist.

  1. ZARAAHMANDO (IRE)
  2. WEGOTOGETHER (IRE)
  3. GREEN KITE (IRE)

races.name: Tote, Never Beaten By SP Maiden
races.verdict:
KEOGIE was a fast-finishing second at Gowran last time and can improve over this additional 1f. Casamorati rates the biggest threat on form, whilst better can be expected second time out from Aidan O'Brien's Noble Irish.

  1. KEOGIE (IRE)
  2. CASAMORATI (IRE)
  3. NOBLE IRISH (IRE)

races.name: Liam & Joan Healy Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
DRAGON OF MALTA recorded back-to-back wins at this course 12 months ago having looked on the way back from a slipping mark in recent starts, Pat O'Donnell's 9-y-o gets the nod over Royal Bones, who has shown plenty of promise in maidens and comes from family particularly effective with cut in ground. Resurgence, Amplitude and Great Mover are just a handful of others worth considering, too.

  1. DRAGON OF MALTA (IRE)
  2. ROYAL BONES (IRE)
  3. RESURGENCE (IRE)

races.name: Kevin's Bar, Listowel/Exchange Inn, Ballybunion Handicap
races.verdict:
WIE WUNDERBAR looked ahead of her opening mark when making a winning handicap debut at Naas 29 days ago and, with further improvement likely for her new yard, is taken to defy a 5 lb rise. Love Orchid is going the right way and knocking on the door, so rates the main danger, while the unexposed Priorstown and Gavin Cromwell's Espritroyale are also respected.

  1. WIE WUNDERBAR
  2. LOVE ORCHID (IRE)
  3. PRIORSTOWN (IRE)
  4. ESPRITROYALE (IRE)

races.name: John McGuire Handicap (Premier Handicap)
races.verdict:
HANDANI got off the mark in good style at Navan 16 days ago and, with this longer trip sure to suit, is taken to make a winning handicap debut. Sharkeyboy disappointed at York last time but had shaped well previously and rates the chief threat, while Sir Jeremy and Tribal Star can also be involved. Reserve Eben Zaabeel would also enter calculations if getting a run.

  1. HANDANI (IRE)
  2. SHARKEYBOY (FR)
  3. SIR JEREMY (IRE)

races.name: Eric Browne Memorial Maiden
races.verdict:
THE AUSTRIAN was a real eye-catcher at the Curragh last time and he can go one place better. Shirzan was first past the post on her Flat debut and should go close to making amends here, with useful jumper Ballybawn Belter also shortlisted.

  1. THE AUSTRIAN (IRE)
  2. SHIRZAN (IRE)
  3. BALLYBAWN BELTER (IRE)

races.name: Gerard Lynch Memorial Handicap
races.verdict:
AFLOAT shaped with encouragement on debut for the Gavin Cromwell yard last time and is awarded the vote with this step up in trip likely to suit. Cooley’s Mist arrives in good form and rates the chief threat, with last-time-out winner Lauderdale King and thorough stayer Way Down South also considered. Deralo Ir needs monitoring in the betting.

  1. AFLOAT
  2. COOLEY'S MIST (IRE)
  3. LAUDERDALE KING (IRE)

races.name: Prix Du Chateau d'Angers Claiming Stakes
Prix Salon Du Cheval (Prix d'Ecouflant) Stakes
Prix Richmond Brissac - Challenge Apgo Maiden Stakes
Prix Mondial Du Lion (Prix Du Chateau Du Roi De Pologne) Handicap
Prix Com De Com Thierache Du Centre - Attele
Prix Des Donneurs D'organes De L'aisne - Attele
Prix Saveurs De Nos Fermes - Attele
